rules.reason: Existing shell controls have compact focus, tooltip, and menu-anchor behavior that must migrate as one keyboard-tested unit.
rules.removalCondition: Replace the remaining direct controls when the shell interaction regression suite covers focus return, mobile navigation, and account-menu anchoring.

rules.reason: Existing administration workflows predate the public Form, Dialog, and Grid contracts and include coupled validation and optimistic-lock behavior.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate each workflow with its desktop, mobile, keyboard, partial-failure, and version-conflict journey; never replace primitives without preserving behavior.

rules.reason: Home composition controls retain legacy compact launch and edit interactions covered by existing product tests.
rules.removalCondition: Remove when Home Studio and launchpad share the design-system action and form contracts with equivalent drag, focus, and empty-state coverage.

rules.reason: Provisioning operations use legacy multi-step forms while external SCIM contracts remain fail-closed.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate alongside the next approved provisioning journey and retain dry-run, retry, secret, and partial-failure evidence.

rules.reason: Directory and organization-design interactions include graph, effective-date, and scenario controls that require domain-level migration rather than mechanical wrapping.
rules.removalCondition: Remove per journey after population policy, effective dating, graph keyboard operation, conflict preview, and mobile inspector tests pass.

rules.reason: Established Provider workflows retain legacy controls around high-risk approval, support, incident, and tenant lifecycle operations.
rules.removalCondition: Convert when each operation uses shared approval and resource patterns with SoD, stale-version, retry, rollback, and audit journey coverage.

rules.reason: The command search dialog has specialized combobox focus and partial-source behavior pending a public command-palette contract.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after a reusable permission-aware command palette ships with keyboard, source-failure, and route-restoration tests.

rules.reason: Layout-level icon actions coordinate responsive navigation and focus restoration across product shells.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after shell primitives own responsive navigation, focus restoration, and compact-mode behavior across all layouts.

rules.reason: Account forms mix autosave, managed-policy, reauthentication, and session controls that require end-to-end migration.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after autosave state, managed policy, reauthentication boundary, session revocation, and mobile keyboard journeys use public contracts.

rules.reason: Account activation is a security-sensitive standalone flow with existing legacy form controls.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after activation, expiry, invalid token, password policy, and screen-reader journeys pass on the shared auth form contract.

rules.reason: A small set of established workspace pages still use direct controls for page-specific command surfaces.
rules.removalCondition: Remove when the owning page is next changed and its representative desktop, mobile, keyboard, empty, and error journeys are migrated together.
